title.narrative: CSR-Facility: Responsible garments and textiles production in Bangladesh

description.narrative:
The overall aim of the project is to facilitate sustainable change in the garment and textiles sector in Bangladesh to contribute to tangible improvements of workers¿ rights and safety through multi-stakeholder dialogue and collaboration.
The project will promote the Danish Partnership for Responsible Garments and Textiles Production in Bangladesh and coordinate the partners¿ actions. It will provide a broad-based international platform for common actions in Bangladesh through joint efforts of the Ethical Trading Initiatives. The project will, through effective multi-stakeholder alliances in Denmark, internationally and loaclly in Bangladesh develop a scalable model of work-place social dialogue for the textiles and ready-made garment sector in Bangladesh and improve industrial relations and respect for workers¿ rights at project factories.
The project will improve networking and relations between participating suppliers and civil society and establish the basis for a Bangladeshi multi-stakeholder initiative for long term local ownership.
